name: SSTI: arith proof -> engine RCE gadget -> OS echo
goal: Escalate template-injection proofs to OS command execution on the detected engine, with a full engine-coverage ladder.
preconditions: Reflected user input rendered by a server-side template engine (including email/PDF template editors).
impact: Arbitrary code/OS command execution as the app user.

steps.purpose: Deterministic engine + eval proof (343 marker) for Jinja2.
steps.on_success: Step 2 for RCE; other engines detected -> swap the sibling proof (Freemarker/Mako/Velocity/ERB).
steps.on_fail: No eval -> client-side reflection -> web/Angular client-side template injection reflection (CSTI).

steps.purpose: Jinja2 gadget chain to OS command.
steps.on_success: Step 3 confirms the OS layer; alternative engines -> web/Twig SSTI RCE map-system gadget, web/Freemarker SSTI RCE Execute gadget.
steps.on_fail: Sandboxed Jinja -> Twig/Freemarker/Mako/ERB siblings; sandbox survives -> document eval-only impact.

steps.purpose: Deterministic uid() marker through the OS layer — converges every engine chain onto one proof shape.
steps.on_success: Full RCE narrative: probe -> gadget -> OS marker.
steps.on_fail: Output blind -> web/Command injection time-based sleep oracle as the blind channel.

recon.name: Polyglot canary injection
recon.how: Inject {{7*7}} ${7*7} <%= 7*7 %> #{7*7} into every reflected parameter, header (UA), and filename.
recon.signal: 49/343 rendered — engine identified by which syntax fires.

recon.name: Template-editor hunt
recon.how: Search the product surface for template/notification/signature editors — these are intended user-facing template sinks.
recon.signal: Editor UI = direct SSTI if server-rendered.

recon.name: Traceback engine reveal
recon.how: Force errors; Jinja/Mako/Freemarker/Twig names in tracebacks tell you which proof to run.

recon.name: Filename reflection
recon.how: Upload/name files with canaries — filenames often pass through templates (attachment names, export titles).
